title: D&D 5.5 SRD Conditions
description: Top-level array of conditions. Each condition's mechanics are grouped into named bullets matching how the SRD writes them; the prose lives in each group's `description` and the machine-readable half in its `effects`.

description.description: Optional lead-in prose. SRD conditions omit it: each effect group's own description carries the rules text, so a condition-level summary would only restate them.

levels.description: Present only on conditions that stack in levels — Exhaustion is the sole SRD example. `derivedValueId` names the counter that effects reference as `$derived:<id>`.

effectGroup.description: The named bullets that make up this condition.
